name: Roman Theatre and its Surroundings and the "Triumphal Arch" of Orange
description: In the town of Orange, in France's Rhône valley, a Roman theatre stands with its huge 103-metre-long stage wall still largely intact, among the best preserved of its kind. Built in the early first century AD, it sits close to a triumphal arch from the reign of Augustus, carved with reliefs celebrating the peace Rome brought to its provinces.
